nodes.label: phoenix_lakehouse
nodes.description: Lakehouse core library providing contracts, definitions, Iceberg catalog config, GCS storage layout, and table contracts for the Proxima energy analytics platform

nodes.label: lakehouse_core
nodes.description: Python package exposing lakehouse config, catalog access, paths, and table identifiers as a clean API for consuming repos

nodes.label: Raw Zone
nodes.description: Immutable storage of source JSON/XML files in GCS for replay and debugging; no Iceberg tables

nodes.label: Bronze Zone
nodes.description: Minimally structured Iceberg tables close to source; may include raw_payload column; first structured format (Parquet)

nodes.label: Silver Zone
nodes.description: Cleaned, normalized, typed Iceberg tables ready for analytics and joining; validated and deduplicated

nodes.label: Gold Zone
nodes.description: Feature/metrics/result Iceberg tables for modeling, dashboards, Monte Carlo outputs; business-ready aggregations

nodes.label: Apache Iceberg
nodes.description: Open table format used as the core abstraction for all structured data across bronze/silver/gold zones

nodes.label: Google Cloud Storage (GCS)
nodes.description: Single data lake storage layer; bucket novagrid-lakehouse is the canonical warehouse

nodes.label: Modular Table Contracts Pattern
nodes.description: Recommended approach: domain-specific YAML files in configs/tables/ rather than inline in lakehouse.yaml; scales better, clear git diffs, auto-merged by config loader

hyperedges.label: Medallion Architecture (Raw/Bronze/Silver/Gold)
hyperedges.description: Four-zone data architecture pattern: raw (immutable source), bronze (minimal structure), silver (cleaned/normalized), gold (business-ready); defines the data maturity progression across the entire lakehouse
